by
  intro x
  have : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
    := by
      rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
      apply tendsto_zero_of_norm_tendsto_zero
      intro n
      have h : (fwdDiff 1)^[n] (⇑f) 0 = 0
        := by
          induction' n with n ih
          case zero => simp [fwdDiff, nat.pow_zero]
          case succ n => 
            rw [fwdDiff_succ, ih]
            simp [fwdDiff, nat.pow_succ]
      exact h
